title: Remote UE Report completion by the network

entities.name: Remote UE Report completion by the network
entities.description: Procedure where the MME responds to a REMOTE UE REPORT message from the UE by sending a REMOTE UE REPORT RESPONSE message.

entities.name: REMOTE UE REPORT
entities.description: Message sent by the UE to the MME containing remote UE information.

entities.name: REMOTE UE REPORT RESPONSE
entities.description: Message sent by the MME to the UE in response to a REMOTE UE REPORT message.

entities.name: Procedure Transaction Identity
entities.description: Identifier included in the REMOTE UE REPORT message and copied into the REMOTE UE REPORT RESPONSE message.

entities.name: MME
entities.description: Mobility Management Entity that processes the REMOTE UE REPORT and sends the response.

relations.description: The procedure is triggered by receipt of the REMOTE UE REPORT message.
The procedure includes sending the REMOTE UE REPORT RESPONSE message.
The REMOTE UE REPORT RESPONSE message includes the PTI from the REMOTE UE REPORT message.
The REMOTE UE REPORT message contains the PTI information element.
The MME performs the procedure upon receipt of the REMOTE UE REPORT message.
